summary: Two miners killed and 19 sickened by carbon monoxide at the Revenue Virginius mine near Ouray; sheriff's office, Ouray Fire District, and Ouray County EMS responded to the 911 call and a mine-rescue operation brought the two underground victims to the surface, both confirmed deceased by the coroner; MSHA investigated
responding_agency: Ouray County Sheriff's Office; Ouray Fire District; Ouray County EMS; Ouray Mountain Rescue; San Juan Mine Rescue
notes: Official county releases dated November 17–18, 2013. Final release corrects the hospitalized count from 20 to 19, in addition to two deaths: victims=21 does not mean 21 fatalities. Preliminary coroner finding was carbon monoxide poisoning; sheriff ruled out explosion and collapse. Industrial mine rescue, not a wilderness recreation incident.
